setup.intro: The console acts in Argo CD as the local account orchestrator, with an API token and no password. Everything it creates has a name starting with mfe-, so the permissions below let it touch only its own objects. Apply these ConfigMaps in the namespace of Argo CD.

permissions.projects: creates and updates the AppProject of the project, which confines its applications to the GitOps repositories and the namespaces of the environments
permissions.applications: reads the Applications of the project and deletes those made by earlier versions of the console
permissions.applicationsets: creates, updates and deletes the ApplicationSets of the environments and of the applications, on every deploy too
permissions.repositories: registers and withdraws the read-only credentials of the repositories. It cannot be narrowed to mfe-: the applications repository is registered globally, and the rule applies to its URL
